## Why
The board-level half of the verbs, and the read that goes with them (`docs/local-first.md` §3 board-level table; §1 items 2 and 5).

## What
1. The board record gains `paused_at`, `paused_by` (`board()`/`setBoard` on the store; on the GitHub store, `state.json` is the fallback with a doctor note that it is host-local).
2. `src/dispatch.js`: a paused board's tick runs outbox replay, reconcile, promote and the finished-card reap, and skips the reclaim loop and the claim loop, logging `board paused since …` once per tick.
3. `src/lifecycle.js`/`src/cli.js`: `hkb pause` (+ every running local attempt via B4, `--keep-workers` skips that), `hkb resume` (only the attempts this host paused, by `paused_by`), `hkb stop` (pause, then `stop <n>` on every running local attempt with `reason: board stop`), `hkb start` (clears the board pause and `suspended` on every card whose reason was `board stop`). `--all`: the verb once per entry of `~/.config/hkb/boards.json` (`loadUserBoards`, `src/board.js`), one line each. `--json`: one object per attempt plus `{ board, paused_since }`.
4. `hkb ps [--all]` (`src/up.js` beside `statusReport`): the process lines of `up --status`, then `paused since`, then one line per running attempt: number, attempt, runtime, state from `inspect`, paused-since.
5. `hkb doctor`: a pause older than 24 h is a `!` line naming `hkb resume`.
6. `skills/kanban/SKILL.md` `/kanban:operate`: the four verbs in "What is yours", the `paused`/`resumed`/`stopped`/`suspended` rows in the reaction table, `hkb ps` in the opening report; `README.md` "Keeping the board running" gains the verbs.

## Done when
- [ ] Tests: a paused board's tick promotes and reconciles but claims nothing and reclaims nothing; `stop` then `start` round-trips two running fake attempts and their cards; `--all` over a temp registry of two boards runs both; `ps --json` shape.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` green; the wiki pages named in `paths` refreshed.

## Contract
B6 runs beside you and owns `src/serve.js`, `web/index.html`, `src/watch.js`: touch nothing there. The board-pause pill in the web board is B6's; you provide `board().paused_at`.

**Read first:** `docs/local-first.md` (the plan; the sections named below), `docs/wiki/decisions/adr-005-control-plane.md`,
`docs/wiki/decisions/adr-006-local-store.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Keep it dependency-free at runtime. Pure logic in
`src/model.js` with a test. Errors name the fix and carry `.exitCode`. `--json` everywhere. Update the wiki page a
change touches (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` lists what went stale); a new feature gets a new page.
Finish with `npm run lint && npm test` green, one draft PR, and exactly one terminal verb.
goal: hkb pause/resume/stop/start without a number act on the board (a column on the board row); a paused board tick claims and reclaims nothing but keeps its bookkeeping; --all runs the verb per registry entry; hkb ps lists processes, paused-since and running attempts with runtime state; doctor warns on a pause older than a day; the operate procedure gains the rows
title: The board verbs and the cluster flag: hkb pause|resume|stop|start with no card, --all over the registry, hkb ps, the operator rows
